entities.summary: Benjamin Matthew Ondrus is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. Ondrus was never drafted by a National Hockey League (NHL) team, however, he signed as a free agent and worked his way up through the Toronto Maple Leafs system, making his NHL debut in 2006. Ondrus played junior hockey in the Western Hockey League for the Swift Current Broncos. While playing in the American Hockey League for the Toronto Marlies, Ondrus served as team captain.
